evidence: The pulse length was varied in different experiments from 10 to 20 s for Cd and Te2 and from 2 to 20 s for Mn. The beam pulses were generated by opening and closing the shutters. Between the pulses all the beams were turned off for a second in order to approach a thermodynamical equilibrium of the surface at the end of each reaction step--a necessary condition for the ALE process.
